_doc: BGM 清单：每条 = 一首 YuE2 器乐（cot:off）。不用 instrumental:true——它把歌词换成单个 [instrumental]，曲子只有约 58 秒，且实测仍有人声；改为歌词只写空乐段标签（lyrics，cue 里可覆盖）撑出结构与时长，style 前加 style_prefix（与服务端 instrumental_style() 同句），成品再用 demucs 去掉 vocals 声部。scripts/gen_bgm.py 读取本文件提交生成、取回、分离、做后期（裁静音/响度/淡出/OGG）。style 写法见 extensions/skills/yue2-prompt。uses 只是给人看的用途说明，游戏里实际用哪首由 src/ui/bgm.gd 与章节 JSON 的 bgm 字段决定。
style_prefix: Instrumental music only; no singing, no vocals, no spoken voice, no choir.

cues.label: 主题曲
cues.uses: 标题画面
cues.style: anime game title theme, upbeat determined J-pop rock fusion with 8-bit chiptune lead, bright square-wave synth melody, driving electric guitar, punchy bass and drums, heroic catchy hook, E major, 150 BPM

cues.label: 菜单
cues.uses: 章节选择、经典战役、图鉴、设置、局外养成、肉鸽开局
cues.style: lo-fi chillhop game menu music, relaxed and cozy, mellow Rhodes electric piano, soft vinyl crackle, warm sub bass, laid-back swung drums, gentle 8-bit arpeggio accents, C major, 84 BPM

cues.label: 日常
cues.uses: 校园、咖啡店等轻松的日常对话（第3、6~10章）
cues.style: anime slice-of-life background music, bright carefree campus afternoon, acoustic guitar strumming, light piano, glockenspiel and pizzicato strings, bouncy shaker groove, cheerful simple melody, G major, 112 BPM

cues.label: 深夜的书桌
cues.uses: 夜晚的房间、学习、下决心（第1章结尾、第2、4章）
cues.style: anime drama background music, quiet late-night study at a desk, introspective solo piano with soft ambient synth pads, faint clock-like pulse, slowly rising sense of resolve, D minor, 76 BPM

cues.label: 失去
cues.uses: 母亲的崩溃与离世（第1章）、敞开的门（第13章）
cues.style: sorrowful anime drama underscore, grief and loss, slow solo piano with mournful cello, sparse string ensemble swells, lots of space and silence, A minor, 60 BPM

cues.label: 父亲的眼泪
cues.uses: 父亲斥责（第5章）、向父亲坦白（第13章）
cues.style: tender emotional anime family scene music, warm but tearful, gentle piano arpeggios, soft violin and viola melody, light acoustic guitar, bittersweet reconciliation feeling, F major, 70 BPM

cues.label: 坚硬的地板
cues.uses: 盯上 EUR/CHF、全仓、烧肉店结算（第10~11章）、第11章回放的平静期
cues.style: suspenseful anime underscore, calm before the storm, uneasy minimalism, ticking clock percussion, low pulsing synth bass, sparse detuned piano notes, subtle dissonant string drones, false sense of safety, C minor, 90 BPM

cues.label: 下一页
cues.uses: 破产手续之后、2017 年的新开始（第13章）
cues.style: hopeful anime ending-scene music, rebirth after hardship, warm piano melody growing into strings and light drums, acoustic guitar, gentle uplifting build, city night after rain, D major, 92 BPM

cues.label: もちもち企画
cues.uses: 公司日常、烧肉欢迎会（第14~15章）
cues.style: quirky comedic anime office music, lively small startup company, bouncy pizzicato strings, ukulele, bassoon and clarinet, glockenspiel, playful hand claps, light-hearted chaos, B-flat major, 122 BPM

cues.label: 交易·练习
cues.uses: 教程交易（第2~6章）、新人的交易（第15章）
cues.style: calm focused electronic game music, learning to read charts, light chillhop beat, soft plucked synth arpeggios, warm electric piano chords, clean bass, curious and encouraging mood, F major, 96 BPM

cues.label: 交易·实战
cues.uses: 剧情交易（第7~10章）、肉鸽普通相場
cues.style: focused trading game background music, sleek synthwave and electronic, steady four-on-the-floor kick, pulsing sequenced synth bass, glassy arpeggios, restrained tension with forward motion, A minor, 118 BPM

cues.label: 交易·危机
cues.uses: 交易中维持率告警或暴走时自动切换（第4、9章等）
cues.style: anxious high-tension electronic game music, margin call panic, racing heartbeat kick, distorted pulsing bass, alarm-like synth stabs, rising risers, frantic hi-hats, dark and urgent, F-sharp minor, 140 BPM

cues.label: 精英
cues.uses: 肉鸽精英节点
cues.style: intense electronic rock game battle music, tough challenge, overdriven guitar riffs, aggressive synth bass, tight driving drums, stuttering synth lead, determined and edgy, E minor, 132 BPM

cues.label: BOSS
cues.uses: 肉鸽第1~2幕 Boss
cues.style: anime game boss battle music, high-stakes showdown, fast electronic rock, heavy distorted guitars, soaring synth lead melody, dramatic orchestral hits, pounding double-time drums, D minor, 155 BPM

cues.label: 最终BOSS
cues.uses: 肉鸽第3幕 Boss（金融危机、黑色星期四）
cues.style: epic final boss battle music, global financial crisis, hybrid orchestral and electronic, massive brass, thunderous taiko and timpani, heavy guitars, frantic string ostinato, heroic desperate climax, C minor, 165 BPM

cues.label: 2008年10月
cues.uses: 特殊：第1章母亲的交易画面（雷曼危机回放）
cues.style: haunting tragic anime underscore, slow-motion market collapse seen through a child's eyes, fragile music box melody, detuned piano, low cello drones, distant warning tones, cold and helpless, B minor, 66 BPM

cues.uses: 特殊：EUR/CHF 下限撤销瞬间起（第11章瑞郎冲击、Boss 黑色星期四）
cues.style: chaotic catastrophic orchestral electronic cue, sudden market crash, blaring brass stabs, screaming string clusters, glitchy distorted synths, alarm sirens, relentless pounding drums, overwhelming panic, C-sharp minor, 170 BPM

cues.label: 最后的100万円
cues.uses: 特殊：第12章 888 倍的最后一搏
cues.style: desperate dark electronic underscore, one last all-in gamble, slow heavy heartbeat kick, hollow distorted bass, ticking hi-hat, tense sustained strings, eerie reversed piano, numb and reckless, G minor, 100 BPM

cues.label: 地图
cues.uses: 肉鸽地图
cues.style: roguelike adventure map music, night city journey, upbeat synth-pop march, bright 8-bit lead melody, punchy bass, crisp drums, hopeful sense of exploration and choice, G major, 112 BPM

cues.label: 商店
cues.uses: 肉鸽商店
cues.style: cheerful game shop music, cozy convenience store, light bossa nova groove, nylon guitar, vibraphone, soft flute melody, upright bass and brushed drums, friendly and relaxing, C major, 100 BPM

cues.label: 休息
cues.uses: 肉鸽休息节点
cues.style: peaceful rest-area game music, late-night convenience store break, lo-fi ambient, warm Rhodes chords, soft rain texture, gentle music box, slow mellow beat, healing and calm, E-flat major, 72 BPM

cues.label: 事件
cues.uses: 肉鸽事件
cues.style: mysterious curious game event music, unexpected encounter, playful plucked strings, marimba and celesta, walking upright bass, light jazzy swing, slightly mischievous mood, D dorian, 96 BPM

cues.label: 2000万円
cues.uses: 肉鸽通关（2000万达成、通关结算）
cues.style: triumphant celebratory anime game ending music, dream finally achieved, soaring heroic melody, full orchestra with bright brass fanfare, rock drums and electric guitar, sparkling bells, euphoric and emotional, E-flat major, 140 BPM

cues.label: 败北
cues.uses: 肉鸽失败结算
cues.style: melancholy game over music, defeat but not the end, gentle sad piano, soft strings, quiet reflective mood, hint of hope in the last phrase, A minor, 66 BPM
